descriptions.d24i_grid_scan_alt_reverse_8010d630: Variant of the grid cell scan 0x8010ca34 walking rows downward, using edge test 0x8010bda0 and triangles 0x8010b43c, reading corners without a header offset: for each passing cell seeks the run-length cursor at +28 and draws corners +1370, +74, +1298 with flag 1 and +74, +1298, +2 with flag 0.
